vulnerabilities.summary: Remote Code Execution via rl_safe_eval sandboxing bypass
vulnerabilities.details: ReportLab legacy versions allow arbitrary Python code execution through improper sanitization of formatted text elements during PDF rendering.

vulnerabilities.summary: Arbitrary path traversal and file overwrite via PDF metadata fields
vulnerabilities.details: Allows unauthenticated local file overwrite when parsing malformed PDF header objects.

vulnerabilities.summary: Malicious credential harvesting and telemetry exfiltration hook
vulnerabilities.details: Harvests AWS, SSH, and environment credentials upon module import and dispatches base64 payloads to rogue external endpoints.

vulnerabilities.summary: Homoglyph supply chain attack targeting requests package
vulnerabilities.details: Impersonates standard requests HTTP client while embedding credential exfiltration hooks in socket transport routines.
